run.Name: run
run.description: Initiate a Postman Collection run from a given URL or path

--bail.Name: --bail
--bail.description: Specify whether or not to gracefully stop a collection run on encountering an error and whether to end the run with an error based on the optional modifier

--cookie-jar.Name: --cookie-jar
--cookie-jar.description: Specify the path to a custom cookie jar (serialized tough-cookie JSON)

--delay-request.Name: --delay-request
--delay-request.description: Specify the extent of delay between requests (milliseconds)

--disable-unicode.Name: --disable-unicode
--disable-unicode.description: Forces Unicode compliant symbols to be replaced by their plain text equivalents

--env-var.Name: --env-var
--env-var.description: Allows the specification of environment variables via the command line, in a key=value format

--environment.Name: --environment
--environment.description: Specify a URL or path to a Postman Environment

--export-collection.Name: --export-collection
--export-collection.description: Exports the executed collection to a file after completing the run

--export-cookie-jar.Name: --export-cookie-jar
--export-cookie-jar.description: Exports the cookie jar to a file after completing the run

--export-environment.Name: --export-environment
--export-environment.description: Exports the final environment to a file after completing the run

--export-globals.Name: --export-globals
--export-globals.description: Exports the final globals to a file after completing the run

--folder.Name: --folder
--folder.description: Specify the folder to run from a collection. Can be specified multiple times to run multiple folders

--global-var.Name: --global-var
--global-var.description: Allows the specification of global variables via the command line, in a key=value format

--globals.Name: --globals
--globals.description: Specify a URL or path to a file containing Postman Globals

--ignore-redirects.Name: --ignore-redirects
--ignore-redirects.description: Prevents Newman from automatically following 3XX redirect responses

--iteration-count.Name: --iteration-count
--iteration-count.description: Define the number of iterations to run

--iteration-data.Name: --iteration-data
--iteration-data.description: Specify a data file to use for iterations (either JSON or CSV)

--no-insecure-file-read.Name: --no-insecure-file-read
--no-insecure-file-read.description: Prevents reading the files situated outside of the working directory

--postman-api-key.Name: --postman-api-key
--postman-api-key.description: API Key used to load the resources from the Postman API

--reporters.Name: --reporters
--reporters.description: Specify the reporters to use for this run

--silent.Name: --silent
--silent.description: Prevents Newman from showing output to CLI

--ssl-client-cert.Name: --ssl-client-cert
--ssl-client-cert.description: Specify the path to a client certificate (PEM)

--ssl-client-cert-list.Name: --ssl-client-cert-list
--ssl-client-cert-list.description: Specify the path to a client certificates configurations (JSON)

--ssl-client-key.Name: --ssl-client-key
--ssl-client-key.description: Specify the path to a client certificate private key

--ssl-client-passphrase.Name: --ssl-client-passphrase
--ssl-client-passphrase.description: Specify the client certificate passphrase (for protected key)

--suppress-exit-code.Name: --suppress-exit-code
--suppress-exit-code.description: Specify whether or not to override the default exit code for the current run

--timeout.Name: --timeout
--timeout.description: Specify a timeout for collection run (milliseconds)

--verbose.Name: --verbose
--verbose.description: Show detailed information of collection run and each request sent

--working-dir.Name: --working-dir
--working-dir.description: Specify the path to the working directory

-d.Name: -d
-d.description: Specify a data file to use for iterations (either JSON or CSV)

-e.Name: -e
-e.description: Specify a URL or path to a Postman Environment

-g.Name: -g
-g.description: Specify a URL or path to a file containing Postman Globals

-n.Name: -n
-n.description: Define the number of iterations to run

-r.Name: -r
-r.description: Specify the reporters to use for this run

-x.Name: -x
-x.description: Specify whether or not to override the default exit code for the current run
